# Thornbury Heating & Cooling

> Serving Thornbury and the wider Grey County region, Thornbury Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (519) 599-0273  |  Email: contact@thornburyheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://thornburyheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Thornbury, Clarksburg, Craigleith, Ravenna, Meaford, Collingwood
